label: Exact algebraic parity construction at N = 42
provenance: Independent nested construction in a variable first-order AC parent within one Dicke-parity sector. Exact rational contraction certifies the full second-order subspace.
derivationLatex: c_{r,a}=\frac{\sqrt{\binom Nr}}{2^{e_r}}(x_{r,a}+i y_{r,a}),\qquad r\equiv0\pmod2,\qquad c_{r,a}=0\text{ otherwise}.

algebraicDefinition.type: Unique zero of a rational quadratic system in a certified rational box, after fixing the other coordinates.

scope: Exact algebraic existence; short radical formulas and unrestricted optimality are not asserted.
